entry.name: Meganium Mega
entry.flavorEs: La fragancia de la flor de Meganium aplaca y suaviza los ánimos. Al luchar, este Pokémon libera mayor cantidad de esencia para disminuir el ánimo de combate de su oponente.

abilities.textEn: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
abilities.textEs: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
abilities.detail: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
abilities.detailEs: Aunque el sol no brille con intensidad, el Pokémon puede usar sus movimientos como si el clima fuera de sol intenso.
abilities.detailZh: 即使日照并未变得强烈，此宝可梦也可以如同在日照强烈的天气下一般使用招式。
abilities.detailPt: Mesmo quando a luz do sol não estiver forte, o Pokémon pode usar seus movimentos como se o clima fosse sol forte.
